source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Abu Lahab's hands have perished and he is wretched for harming the Messenger of Allah, Muhammad (peace be upon him); and Abu Lahab's ruin has indeed come to pass.
tafsir.muyassar-2: His wealth and his children did not avail him; they will not ward off any of Allah's punishment when it befalls him.
tafsir.muyassar-3: He will enter the blazing Fire of Hell, he and his wife —
tafsir.muyassar-4: she who used to carry thorns and throw them in the path of the Prophet (peace be upon him) to harm him.
tafsir.muyassar-5: Around her neck is a tightly twisted rope of coarse, rough fiber, by which she will be raised up in the Fire of Hell and then thrown down to its depths.
